gloss: activities aimed at conceiving; fertility efforts

definitions.gloss: activities and efforts aimed at becoming pregnant
definitions.explanation: Informal abbreviation of {妊娠|にんしん}{活動|かつどう} (pregnancy activities). Refers to the lifestyle adjustments, medical consultations, and fertility treatments a couple undertakes when trying to conceive.

examples.japanese: {妊活|にんかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It has been half a year since we started trying to conceive.

examples.japanese: {妊活|にんかつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to the hospital as part of our fertility efforts.

examples.japanese: {妊活|にんかつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧や⟦{生活習慣|せいかつしゅうかん}→生活習慣：19568_seikatsushuukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: When trying to conceive, it is said that reviewing your diet and lifestyle habits is important.

notes:
A blended abbreviation (⟦かばん→かばん：00637_kaban⟧語) of ⟦{妊娠|にんしん}→妊娠：12227_ninshin⟧ (pregnancy) + ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (activities). Emerged in mainstream use in the 2010s. It encompasses the full range of efforts — from timing intercourse and dietary changes to fertility treatments and medical consultations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {妊活|にんかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make efforts to conceive
- {妊活|にんかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める: to start trying to conceive
- {妊活|にんかつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to tackle fertility efforts
- {妊活|にんかつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: in the process of trying to conceive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不妊治療|ふにんちりょう}: infertility treatment — specifically medical procedures for couples with diagnosed infertility
